story.title: Basket count stays behind after taking an item out
story.description: After a shopper takes a product out of the basket, the header basket count must go down at once; a cached count is only refreshed on a change of screen, so the header shows the old number until then.

acceptance_criteria: Given a basket with N products, when the shopper takes one out on the basket screen, then the header basket count shows N-1 without changing screen.
Given the shopper takes out the last product, when the basket becomes empty, then the header basket count is hidden (not shown as "0").
Given the shopper has taken a product out, when they go to another screen and back, then the basket count still shows the right number.

risks.description: The basket count keeps the old number after a take-out until the shopper changes screen, misstating the basket when the shopper decides whether to check out.
When the basket becomes empty the count shows "0" or stays visible instead of hiding, suggesting a product that is not there.
